scope: Focused Node publisher and rejected-runtime preflights only; no Core VM, Native CLI, Cargo, browser or performance acceptance.

actual_failures.cause: cargo-clippy was not installed for the pinned1.95.0 toolchain; linting never ran and workspace tests were skipped.
cargo-fmt was not installed for the pinned1.95.0 toolchain; formatting checks never ran.
Trusted asset-encoding.js now imports image-dimensions.mjs, but the publisher rejected every import before validation.
Two test helpers called mkdtemp under .cache without creating that parent.

fixes: Ordinary CI explicitly installs clippy/rustfmt into its active pinned toolchain; gates remain enabled.
Each affected test helper creates its own .cache parent before mkdtemp.
Publisher allows only the exact fixed canonical named image-dimensions import. SDK index/byte/hash checks cover the dependency independently; export dependency bytes must match.
Only captured trusted SDK/repository bytes are imported through data URLs. Input-export JavaScript is not executed. Bare, escaping, dynamic, comment-separated imports and re-exports remain rejected.

source_review.scope: Bounded source-only review; final comment-separated re-export guard re-read clear. Reviewers did not claim workload execution.

limits: These are Node publisher and rejected-runtime preflight tests, not Core VM/WASM or Native application tests.
No local Cargo, Native CLI, browser, full Web suite or performance measurement was run for this gate.
Rust component installation and actual formatter/clippy outcomes await ordinary CI; this record does not claim all CI green.
The source fixes were uncommitted at this gate. Root controls commit/push and pending sampler CI.
